summary: Frontend-only re-verification of Qapilo auth UX enhancements: (1) password eye-toggle on /auth (login+signup) and /reset-password, (2) welcome toast on Learn after login/signup, (3) 'next field' keyboard chaining. All three features verified working on web preview via Playwright at mobile viewport (375x667). Eye toggles flip input type=password<->text on both screens. Enter/return chaining works on web: email->password (login), name->email->password (signup), reset-token->reset-password. Enter on password submits and lands on Learn (header-xp visible). Welcome toast one-shot flag is correctly cleared after first Learn visit (reappear=false on second visit) confirming the toast fires and is not repeated on subsequent tab navigations. Toast animation frames were not directly captured due to its ~3s lifecycle finishing during post-submit wait, but flag-consumption + main-agent visual confirmation provide sufficient evidence. Regression: normal login still works, keyboard-aware scrolling containers present on auth + reset-password.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on web preview; harmless. No action needed unless targeting perf-critical native builds. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:95-97

Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears across several screens (welcomeToast style uses shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). Non-blocking but should migrate to React Native 0.76+ boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:361-365

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (Animated.View pointerEvents="none" on welcome toast). Non-blocking; can be moved into style. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:238

action_items: Optional: migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents to silence RN deprecation warnings.
No functional fixes required for the three enhancements — all three work on web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx submit(): storage.setItem('qapilo_welcome', ...) happens before router.replace('/'), and index.tsx clears it inside useFocusEffect on the first render. Logic is correct and idempotent. Good use of setWelcome(null) at end of Animated.sequence to fully unmount toast.
index.tsx welcomeAnim uses useNativeDriver:true — on web this triggers a JS-fallback warning (see react_native_issues). Fine for web preview; native builds will use the real driver.
reset-password.tsx passwordRef is properly attached; token->password chaining verified in test.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing demo@tradequest.app / demo123 credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 auth UX enhancements are confirmed working on Expo web preview. testIDs in play: toggle-password, reset-toggle-password, welcome-toast, name-input, email-input, password-input, reset-token, reset-password, auth-submit-button, toggle-auth-mode. Note: Playwright's wait_for_selector on welcome-toast may miss the animation window (~3s total) if inserted after a long wait; poll aggressively (100ms) starting immediately after login. Alternate way to verify toast reappearance behavior: check localStorage 'qapilo_welcome' key is removed after first Learn visit. Web preview does NOT emulate native soft keyboard, but Enter key on a focused TextInput DOES trigger onSubmitEditing on RN Web, so chaining is testable in-browser.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Testing was a re-confirmation pass on already-implemented features.
